display_description.he: תיאום כלי אבטחה ישראליים — Wiz, Snyk, Check Point ועוד
display_description.en: Coordinate Israeli-built cybersecurity tools for security operations including threat triage, vulnerability management, compliance checking, and incident response. Use when user mentions security operations, "SOC", vulnerability scanning, threat triage, compliance assessment, or asks to coordinate Wiz, Snyk, Check Point, CyberArk, SentinelOne, Armis, Torq, or Pentera tools. Embeds Israeli security best practices including INCD guidelines and Israeli Privacy Protection Law compliance. Do NOT use for offensive security testing or creating exploits.
